content.title: Union Pacific CEO talks US innovation, Norfolk Southern deal
content.description:
Union Pacific (UNP) CEO Jim Vena sits down with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi at the Ford Pro Accelerate forum to discuss the railroad operator's workforce, President Trump's vision for US manufacturing, and the company's $85 billion deal with Norfolk Southern (NSC).

Also catch Brian Sozzi's full interview with Ford (F) CEO Jim Farley.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
